about: COURSE_REQUIRED_ROBOTS: the simulator robots the course needs. Each must stay "status": "active" in public/robots/index.json (checked by tests/robot-status.test.mjs). Every other robot is under_test. Lesson references: parity/reports/COURSE_ROBOT_REFERENCES.md. turtlesim and the course's own packages (chiku_control, chiku_control_cpp, ...) run in the lesson terminals and are not simulator robots.

tb3_burger.why: Owner decision 2026-10-23: course robot. Lesson R4 (TURTLEBOT3_MODEL=burger, turtlebot3_gazebo turtlebot3_world.launch.py).

tb3_waffle.why: Legacy (same base as the Waffle Pi, RealSense camera). Active because lesson RV2 tells students to choose TurtleBot3 Waffle on the Simulator page (content/course-content.json:28383).

ur5e.why: Owner decision 2026-10-23: the UR arm of the UR/XT/RV lessons. Lesson UR7 RViz block ("robot": "ur5e").

chiku.why: Owner decision 2026-10-23: the chiku URDF. Lessons UR4, RV2, RV4 RViz blocks ("robot": "chiku").

chiku_mesh.why: Lesson XT4 RViz block edits its file /robots/chiku_description/urdf/chiku_mesh.urdf.xacro (the chiku URDF with meshes).

arm6.why: Robots used by lessons stay active: lesson UR7 RViz block ("robot": "arm6").

hexapod.why: Robots used by lessons stay active: lesson XT3 RViz block ("robot": "hexapod").

quadcopter.why: Lesson RV6 gallery block opens with it ("robot": "quadcopter", gallery: true). Kept active on Night 1; owner to confirm (UNRESOLVED in COURSE_ROBOT_REFERENCES.md).
